# The Pragmatic Programmer for Codex

Generated by scripts/build-targets.mjs from plugins/pragmatic-programmer/ in the guided-plugins repository.

- Skills: 32 workflow and rule skills plus 6 mode skills, invoked as `$pragmatic-programmer:<name>` or from `/skills`.
- Subagents: 20 roles in `../agents/pragmatic-programmer-*.toml`. Codex plugins cannot bundle subagents, so install them with `node scripts/install-codex-agents.mjs pragmatic-programmer`.
- Always-on rules: see `../../rules/pragmatic-programmer/`.

Full instructions: docs/AGENTS_SUPPORT.md in the repository.
